usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/maps/forward?q=<url-encoded address>&limit=<N> (x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.008/call). NOTE: registry lists POST but POST returns 404 — must use GET.
usage.outputShape: body.results[].lat, body.results[].lng, body.results[].display_name, body.results[].address{house_number,road,city,state,postcode,country,country_code}, body.results[].boundingbox[], body.results[].type, body.results[].place_id; body.count = number of matches; body.query = echoed query
quirks: Registry CALL says POST /maps/forward but POST returns 404 'Cannot POST /maps/forward' — you MUST use GET.
Address goes in the q= query param (NOT address=, NOT a JSON body). The endpoint reads query string, not request body.
Real price is fixed $0.008 USDC on Base (8000 atomic units), not 'Varies'.
Optional limit= query param caps number of results (default returns multiple; limit=1 for single best match).
Backed by OpenStreetMap Nominatim; result fields mirror Nominatim (display_name, boundingbox as string array, importance, etc.).
usage.guide: Forward geocode an address to coordinates with a paid x402 GET. Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/maps/forward?q=<url-encoded address>&limit=1 — the wallet pays ~$0.008 USDC on Base automatically via the 402 flow. Do NOT POST and do NOT send a JSON body; the address must be in the q= query param. Read the answer from body.results[0].lat and body.results[0].lng (plus body.results[0].address for components and body.results[0].boundingbox for the bbox). body.count tells you how many matches were found.
